what_it_does: Accelerates dynamic neural networks on specialized hardware by intelligently routing computation through multiple pre-optimized code paths. Dynamic neural networks skip calculations for easy inputs and apply expensive processing only when needed, but current accelerators waste this efficiency potential because their resource allocation is fixed for worst-case inputs. Adyna observes the actual distribution of work at runtime and selects which optimized kernel (pre-compiled code routine) to execute for each layer, adjusting resources dynamically to match the input difficulty.
